def solution():
    # Define variables in millions of dollars
    current_value_before_fees = 320.0
    management_fee_rate = 0.02
    prior_year_aum = 350.0
    prior_year_return = 0.20

    # Calculate the high-water mark and fees
    high_water_mark = prior_year_aum * (1 + prior_year_return)
    management_fee = current_value_before_fees * management_fee_rate
    incentive_fee = max(0.0, current_value_before_fees - high_water_mark) * 0.30

    # Calculate ending capital
    ending_capital = current_value_before_fees - management_fee - incentive_fee

    return round(ending_capital, 1)
